description: §5 / §22 (S459 round 6, F2) — the clean twin of emit-single-quoted-attr-reject: a single quote INSIDE a double-quoted attribute value in emitted meta markup (`title="go('a')"`) is ordinary value content, not a delimiter, and compiles. (S460 merge: the vehicle was `onclick="go('a')"`; #1367's §22.4.1 closed attribute list now refuses event-handler attributes in emit() output, so the vehicle moved to `title=` — the property under test is unchanged.)
rationale: SPEC §5: the attribute quoted-string form is `"`-only; a `'` inside a `"…"` value is part of the value.
